name: Differentiable Point-Based Pipeline with Per-View Optimization
definition: A general approach initialized with MVS that allows further optimization of scene properties (depth and reprojected features) in the space of input views to improve novel-view synthesis, using a differentiable point-based pipeline.
summary: This neural rendering pipeline uses differentiable point-splatting with per-view optimization to correct MVS errors, offering faster and more stable novel-view synthesis than volumetric NeRFs.
